integrity: Exact equations are given with a checkable local-to-global proof. Symbolic and finite-field checks are corroboration, not substitutes for the infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: The universal discriminant and its normality are known; the exceptional double-line incidence has prior coverage. The new combination and the H^1 obstruction need independent priority and specialist validation. No claim extends beyond ternary quadrics in characteristic two.
title: A crepant projective-bundle resolution and nonsplit affine-plane torsor for the characteristic-two conic discriminant
